name: StackColumnsNode
label: Stack Columns
description: Stacks the values of multiple columns vertically into a single column. Each source column's values become additional rows, keeping the remaining (identifier) columns.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to stack columns from.

fields.name: ColumnsToStack
fields.label: Columns To Stack
fields.description: Comma-separated column names to stack into a single column.

fields.name: ResultColumn
fields.label: Result Column
fields.description: The name of the column that holds the stacked values. Defaults to 'StackedValue'.

fields.name: SourceColumnColumn
fields.label: Source Column Column
fields.description: Optional name for a column that records which source column each value came from. Leave empty to omit it.
